Filmmaker Sanjay Gupta Dies at 57 or 59; Accidental Death Confirmed

Filmmaker Sanjay Gupta, known for directing films such as 'Kaante', 'Shootout at Wadala', and 'Kaabil', has died. Reports indicate his age as either 57 or 59. The Mumbai Police confirmed his death as accidental, with no foul play suspected. He passed away in Mumbai and was cremated at the Versova crematorium. Actor Hrithik Roshan, who worked with Gupta on 'Kaabil', paid tribute to him.
